scope: Exploratory SigLIP 2 B/16 follow-up on the fixed cub100 split after its CLIP results were inspected. Native 224 rectangular resize and 768-dimensional embeddings, masks recomputed for full resized views. Frozen backbone, same five matched fusion variants, 3 seeds, 2 learning rates, 400 updates. Fixed temperature 20 for all variants preserves native zero-shot ranking; no claim of native calibrated probabilities. Baseline and controls share native SigLIP preprocessing. This changes backbone, pretraining and preprocessing together; no isolated architecture claim. All selections locked before final SigLIP feature extraction.
